expression: A bad workman always blames his tools.
A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
korean_meaning: 숲 속의 두 마리 새보다 수중의 새 한 마리가 실속이 있다.

expression: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
A leopard cannot change its spots.
A rolling stone gathers no moss.
korean_meaning: 구르는 돌에는 이끼가 끼지 않는다. 한 우물을 파라.

expression: A sound mind in a sound body.
A stitch in time saves nine.
korean_meaning: 제 때의 한 바늘이 내일의 아홉 바늘을 덜어준다.

expression: All that glitters is not gold.

korean_meaning: 늦게라도 하는 것이 안 하는 것보다 더 낫다.

expression: Do to others as you would be done by.
korean_meaning: 네가 대접받고 싶은 대로 남에게 대접하라.

expression: Don’t count your chickens before they are hatched.
Don’t put all your eggs in one basket.
Don’t bite off more than you can chew.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
He laughs best who laughs last.
Heaven helps those who help themselves.
It never rains but it pours.
Make hay while the sun shines.
One man’s meat is another man’s poison.
Slow and steady wins the race.
So many men, so many minds.
Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
Strike while the iron is hot.
The early bird catches the worm.
The grass always looks greener on the other side of the fence.
There is a time for everything.
Time and tide wait for no man.
Too many cooks spoil the broth.
Two heads are better than one.
You can’t eat your cake and have it too.
korean_meaning: 두 마리 토끼를 좇을 수 없다.
